title: Wick Liquor Blue Moon 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Blue Moon is a sophisticated berry vape with a cool edge. It combines the deep, sweet notes of ripe blueberries with the tart tang of ruby raspberries, all frozen into a solid block of ice. This blend offers a sharp, clean, and intensely refreshing fruit experience perfect for all-day vaping. Manufactured in Staffordshire, Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand famous for its "big block" approach to flavour, offering some of the most distinct and high-quality blends on the market. This Nic Salt version offers the same legendary taste in a smooth format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with refillable pod vape kits and starter vape kits , producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liquor Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
